subject.title: feat(agents): bound embedded runs with config-driven budgets

question: Should OpenClaw add and support this five-ceiling embedded-agent runBudget configuration and its OpenAI-compatible terminal envelope as a long-lived core contract?
rationale: The change is intentionally opt-in, but it expands the public configuration and gateway behavior substantially; code review cannot decide whether this is the preferred operator-facing control model over existing run-timeout and execution controls.

options.title: Sponsor the bounded-run contract
options.body: Accept runBudget as a core capability, require public docs and real runtime proof, then review the API semantics and defaults as a stable contract.

options.title: Narrow to an existing control
options.body: Ask for a smaller change that extends the established timeout or execution-control path instead of adding five new durable settings.

options.title: Keep it external or deferred
options.body: Defer the new policy surface until a concrete operator workflow and core ownership case are established.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the bounded-run contract
recommendation.body: Accept runBudget as a core capability, require public docs and real runtime proof, then review the API semantics and defaults as a stable contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision concerns the permanent core agent-runtime and configuration product boundary rather than a mechanical implementation detail.
